title: SAP DIAG: harden variable-length item parsing
description:
While working on !8973 and !26126, I spotted a few packets reported as malformed while
those were valid SAP GUI generatted trafic. Those mostly surface in parts
of the payload that's compressed.

Validate APPL item headers and declared value lengths before accessing
their contents. Restrict item dissection to a subset tvbuff matching the
declared value length so malformed items cannot consume subsequent data.

Also bound dynamic atom and menu strings to their enclosing entries,
validate their minimum fixed-length fields, and stop dissection when a
fixed-length item is truncated.

This prevents malformed or truncated DIAG items from causing out-of-bounds
exceptions or being decoded using bytes from adjacent items.
